items.topic: Which Vrooli resources does this idea need?
items.context: Vrooli scenarios compose local resources (postgres, redis, ollama, qdrant, etc.). Identifying resource dependencies early shapes architecture and feasibility.

options.rationale: No external resource dependencies needed

options.label: Small — single component, < 1 day of work
